messages:
Clara (partnerships): Quick sync — we need to package SOC2, pen-test report, vendor questionnaire responses, and sample contracts for Azure + GCP marketplace listings. Proposing an "artifact index" (spreadsheet + S3 paths) and clear owners for each artifact. Who can own collection + upload + verification?
Priya (security): I can own collection of SOC2 + pen-test PDFs. Will need scope notes and confirmation that any PII was removed. What's the preferred S3 layout?
Clara (partnerships): Proposed layout: s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/{marketplace}/{year}/{artifact-type}/{filename}. Example: s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/azure/2026/soc2/redwood-soc2-2025.pdf
Marco (product): Product will validate screenshots/docs that reference feature flags or unreleased APIs. Jin, can eng produce sanitized screenshots and example traces?
Jin (eng): Yep. I'll have eng generate sanitized traces/screenshots. Will also publish a tiny script to strip IDs. Example:
```
python scripts/sanitize_logs.py --input logs/ --out sanitized/
```
Tess (legal): Legal will review contracts + any CAs. We need a countersigned MSA copy for marketplace listing. If providing redacted contracts, include a redaction-key doc explaining redactions.
Priya (security): :thumbsup: I'll add a column 'PII_sanitized' and 'scope_notes' in the sheet. Also will attach pen-test attestation (vendor sign-off) where present.
Clara (partnerships): Shared a starter sheet (placeholder): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1X-example — columns: artifact_id, marketplace, artifact_type, owner, s3_path, accessible, notes
Marco (product): Suggest adding 'last_verified' and 'visibility' (public/partner/internal). Also add a quick checkbox for 'requires-redaction' so we don't miss anything.
Clara (partnerships): Good call. For pen-tests we need remediation attestations or documented risk acceptances from whoever owns the vulnerable component.
Jin (eng): Ops question — where should final artifacts live? Do we use a dedicated bucket or a lockbox? Ops-bot used to create presigned URLs for partners.
Ops-bot: Ops-bot: Created bucket policy template at s3://infra-templates/marketplace-policy.json. I can generate temp presigned URLs on request and set expiry.
Priya (security): Timeline proposal: index + SOC/pen PDFs uploaded and verified by EOD Thu 2026-04-02. Is that feasible?
Tess (legal): Legal tentatively OK on that timeline pending MSA countersign. If we need redactions, add 2 business days.
Clara (partnerships): Assigning owners in the sheet: Priya -> SOC/pen PDFs; Jin -> sanitized screenshots/logs; Marco -> product validation; Tess -> contracts. I'll update sheet and ping weekly. Thanks everyone!
